name: Jesús Enrique Roncal Huatta
headline: Senior Software Engineer | AI & Backend
summary: Senior software engineer with 8+ years across backend systems, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, the last 4+ building and operating production LLM-powered applications. Most recently Technical Lead on two AI products, and currently AI Engineer on a third, designing multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, and evaluation frameworks for real users at scale. Daily hands-on with AI coding agents (Claude Code) and with Claude, Gemini, and GPT APIs. Ship and operate services on AWS and GCP in Python, Go, Java, and TypeScript, with earlier production experience in PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter). Strong cross-functional collaborator across distributed US, EU, and LATAM teams.

roles.title: AI Engineer
bullets: Design and operate the production LLM system behind Nauta, Innova Schools' teacher platform, on Gemini 2.5 Pro and 3.x (Vertex AI), generating curriculum-aligned lesson plans for Peru, Colombia and Mexico: ~25K requests, 23K+ sessions and 362 active teachers in four weeks, at ~$0.09 per plan.

Proposed the move from n8n to a Spring Boot / Spring AI service (Java 21) and became its second-largest contributor; it runs on AWS ECS (DEV/STG/PRD) with SemVer-versioned prompts, per-call cost monitoring and a 19-panel Grafana dashboard.

Shipped the unit-generation engine (v3): concurrent batch generation of whole units with per-session fault tolerance and deterministic guardrails (zero extra LLM calls), powering 14.9K pregenerated sessions.

Led the move of 15 AI tasks to Gemini 3.x with a paired-measurement harness on production cases (cost, latency, LLM-as-judge quality), at +2.9% total cost; built a conversational editing-agent POC on Google ADK (gate, planner, parallel executor).
Own AI cost governance: monthly Executive Committee reporting reconciled against the cloud invoice, a per-country cost model, an approved budget band and Slack budget alerts.
Earlier, for NGR (via La Victoria Lab's Salto program), built a WhatsApp sales assistant for Bembos on Azure OpenAI GPT-4o with function-calling intent detection.

roles.title: Technical Lead - AI Products
bullets: Owned code review and release gating across two AI products (Freya, an AI writing partner; Reeve, an AI commerce-growth platform); drove 6-8 PRs/session to production with empirical pre-merge gates (pytest, tsc/Vitest, Alembic replays) and set engineering standards (spec-driven development, branching strategy, Linear as state bus).

Led the Reeve MVP merge campaign: 112 PRs across 4 repos cleared from queue to production in ~30h, orchestrating parallel Claude Code agents (isolated worktrees, rebase-by-content, stacked chains) with serial no-new-failures merge gates, unblocking CI (sharding, env-dependent tests) along the way.

Co-architected Freya's AI layer as Technical Lead, authoring its "hourglass" model (many input channels feed one facts-only knowledge base that drives prose generation, with inbound and outbound subagents), and hardened it for production: unified model routing, per-project isolation, real token/cost tracking and non-blocking AI calls. The platform spans 7 RAG-grounded agents, a knowledge-graph consistency engine and Yjs/CRDT editing on FastAPI (900+ endpoints).

Designed a multi-agent orchestration system (Coordinator / Manager / Worker tiers) routing user requests across 8 messaging channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Teams, Signal, iMessage, WebChat).

Eliminated a chronic production AI-cost leak (~$12-16/day to $0) by root-causing an unattributed spend bucket to a stale worker pointed at the production database; shipped a code guard and verified $0 in the prod ledger.
Stabilized backend CI: took a Postgres / pytest-xdist baseline from 11 flaky failures to 0 by reproducing CI byte-for-byte in Docker and root-causing a stale SQLAlchemy comparator memoization.

Built mindfortress-claude, a portable engineering platform (7 agents, 10 commands, skills, git hooks, MCP integrations: Linear, Slack, Railway, Vercel, AWS, Sentry, Stripe) with config-vs-logic separation and layered prod-ops authorization gates.
Shipped Stripe billing with subscription enforcement and A/B testing, and ran multi-cloud production operations (Railway GraphQL + cost ledger, AWS EC2/SSH + Alembic deploys).

roles.title: Backend Developer (concurrent)
bullets: Built and operated the backend for a video platform in Django / PostgreSQL on AWS, owning the storage, upload and update pipelines for very large media files with asynchronous, queue-based processing on AWS SQS.
Modeled video metadata for filtering and search and implemented search with Elasticsearch.
Integrated Stripe for payments and content management on the platform.

roles.title: Backend Developer & AI Engineer
bullets: Integrated Google and OpenAI LLMs into the content pipeline for automated transcription, translation, and adaptive learning, serving 500,000+ users across 10+ markets and lifting user satisfaction 35%.
Designed asynchronous, event-driven processing with Redis and Google Cloud Pub/Sub to decouple services across the content platform.
Refactored core services from Python to Go, reducing API latency 40% and supporting a 50% increase in concurrent users.

roles.title: Backend Developer - Freelance (concurrent, part-time)
bullets: Built APIs serving predictive ML models, primarily in Python with PHP (Laravel) services, achieving 95% test coverage; improved CI/CD, accelerating deployment cycles 40% (Indra, Peru).
Built backend systems and APIs primarily in Go, also delivering PHP (Laravel) services, for gaming, finance, and DNA-sequencing data processing (Pretty Technical, Netherlands; client: Elimbio, USA).

roles.title: Backend Developer
bullets: Internationalized Yachay (yachay.lat), a web hosting and domain platform serving 11,000+ businesses, driving 25% revenue growth in new markets.

roles.title: Software Engineer / IT Support Analyst L3
bullets: Progressed from L3 IT Support to Software Engineer, building web applications and REST APIs in PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter and pure PHP); integrated satellite applications with transactional databases and reporting services.
